title: Signed App Bundles and Artifact Identity Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies signed app bundles and artifact identity?
options: Verify and record the final immutable artifact and its delivered signing identity before upload.
Install the AAB directly on devices
Use the upload fingerprint for delivered-app API restrictions
questions.answer: Verify and record the final immutable artifact and its delivered signing identity before upload.
questions.explanation: This answer preserves the underlying platform or delivery contract while requiring representative evidence, explicit failure behaviour, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: Google Play distributes the uploaded AAB file directly to every device.
questions.explanation: Uploading whichever AAB is newest in a shared directory can publish bytes that do not match the approved revision or recorded checksum.

questions.prompt: Which key signs APKs delivered through Play App Signing?
questions.answer: The app-signing key managed by Play; the developer upload key authenticates the uploaded bundle.
questions.explanation: The response identifies the mechanism that makes the decision reliable instead of relying on a convenient proxy.
